By Using Some Magic and a few pumpkin shards you can make yourself a Tasty Space Pumpkin Latte. This Latte Does taste a bit similar to a pumpkin spice latte, but rumor has it, The Pumpkin Space Latte taste is full of Flavor and Otherworld Deliciousness. No One knows yet how many of These Pumpkin Space Lattes will be available but your going to want to get at least 1 while you still can.

blends.name: Pumpkin Beer Along The Vines
blends.desc:
This Pumpkin Beer was found along the vines in a Pumpkin Patch. Even When This Beer Was Poured into a Nice Cold Frosty Mug, The Vines Still Grew, but didn't affect the flavor of this beer or damage the Mug, or spill any of the delicious Beer. This Beer Tastes Like a combination of Blood Oranges, and Pumpkin. 


--- Most of This Drawing was done By Hand With Colored Pencils, and This Beer is also the result of a Blend that requires some Pumpkin Shards!!
